{__time__=1791774709, __topic__=, __tag__:kubemaker=aistudio-mhmgjdsy, __source__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:owner=415719, __tag__:__phynode__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:__user_defined_id__=kmaker-sa127-03-aidc,kmaker-main,tnlog-main-all, __tag__:component=training, __tag__:app=pytorch, __pack_num__=2529, __tag__:__env__=prod, __pack_offset__=1828, __tag__:__POD_NAME__=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, content=先看合肥沛顿，这是这次扩产的重头戏，总投入8.3亿元。合肥基地本身就和长鑫存储的晶圆厂一街之隔，属于典型的“贴厂配套”模式，这次扩产主要聚焦DRAM晶圆级封装和HBM先进封装。按照规划，项目完全达产后，合肥基地的月产能将从当前的8.2万片直接提升到16万片，相当于产能直接翻倍。, __pack_shard_id__=319, __tag__:__hostname__=gpulingjun033184127160.sa127, __tag__:POD_NAME=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, __tag__:__alipay_zone__=CZ50C, __tag__:__path__=/home/admin/logs/kubemaker.log, __tag__:aistudio=aistudio-345541506, __tag__:__pack_id__=EFA235411D80D906-6A, __pack_cursor__=MTc2NTc5MDMzNjUzNjQ0NDg3Mw==}

{__time__=1791774709, __topic__=, __tag__:kubemaker=aistudio-mhmgjdsy, __source__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:owner=415719, __tag__:__phynode__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:__user_defined_id__=kmaker-sa127-03-aidc,kmaker-main,tnlog-main-all, __tag__:component=training, __tag__:app=pytorch, __pack_num__=2529, __tag__:__env__=prod, __pack_offset__=1829, __tag__:__POD_NAME__=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, content=最关键的是，这个产能不是等到2027年才落地。根据产业链的最新进展，合肥基地的二期扩产在今年年中就已经进入设备安装调试阶段，下半年就会正式启动产能爬坡，第三季度就能逐步贡献产能。换句话说，今年的中报、三季报，大家大概率就能看到扩产带来的实打实营收增量。, __pack_shard_id__=319, __tag__:__hostname__=gpulingjun033184127160.sa127, __tag__:POD_NAME=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, __tag__:__alipay_zone__=CZ50C, __tag__:__path__=/home/admin/logs/kubemaker.log, __tag__:aistudio=aistudio-345541506, __tag__:__pack_id__=EFA235411D80D906-6A, __pack_cursor__=MTc2NTc5MDMzNjUzNjQ0NDg3Mw==}

{__time__=1791774709, __topic__=, __tag__:kubemaker=aistudio-mhmgjdsy, __source__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:owner=415719, __tag__:__phynode__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:__user_defined_id__=kmaker-sa127-03-aidc,kmaker-main,tnlog-main-all, __tag__:component=training, __tag__:app=pytorch, __pack_num__=2529, __tag__:__env__=prod, __pack_offset__=1833, __tag__:__POD_NAME__=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, content=说白了，这次扩产不是临时起意炒概念，是完全跟着下游客户的需求走的——长鑫存储在扩大晶圆产能，长江存储在推进更高层数的NAND技术，海外AI服务器厂商在持续加单DDR5和HBM，深科技作为封测环节的核心厂商，扩产既是顺势而为，也是保住市场份额的必然选择。, __pack_shard_id__=319, __tag__:__hostname__=gpulingjun033184127160.sa127, __tag__:POD_NAME=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, __tag__:__alipay_zone__=CZ50C, __tag__:__path__=/home/admin/logs/kubemaker.log, __tag__:aistudio=aistudio-345541506, __tag__:__pack_id__=EFA235411D80D906-6A, __pack_cursor__=MTc2NTc5MDMzNjUzNjQ0NDg3Mw==}

{__time__=1791774709, __topic__=, __tag__:kubemaker=aistudio-mhmgjdsy, __source__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:owner=415719, __tag__:__phynode__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:__user_defined_id__=kmaker-sa127-03-aidc,kmaker-main,tnlog-main-all, __tag__:component=training, __tag__:app=pytorch, __pack_num__=2513, __tag__:__env__=prod, __pack_offset__=1181, __tag__:__POD_NAME__=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, content=先看合肥沛顿，这是这次扩产的重头戏，总投入8.3亿元。合肥基地本身就和长鑫存储的晶圆厂一街之隔，属于典型的“贴厂配套”模式，这次扩产主要聚焦DRAM晶圆级封装和HBM先进封装。按照规划，项目完全达产后，合肥基地的月产能将从当前的8.2万片直接提升到16万片，相当于产能直接翻倍。, __pack_shard_id__=335, __tag__:__hostname__=gpulingjun033184127160.sa127, __tag__:POD_NAME=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, __tag__:__alipay_zone__=CZ50C, __tag__:__path__=/home/admin/logs/kubemaker.log, __tag__:aistudio=aistudio-345541506, __tag__:__pack_id__=EFA235411D80D906-6D, __pack_cursor__=MTc2NTc2OTkyNDQ4MjA3NTI5OA==}

{__time__=1791774709, __topic__=, __tag__:kubemaker=aistudio-mhmgjdsy, __source__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:owner=415719, __tag__:__phynode__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:__user_defined_id__=kmaker-sa127-03-aidc,kmaker-main,tnlog-main-all, __tag__:component=training, __tag__:app=pytorch, __pack_num__=2513, __tag__:__env__=prod, __pack_offset__=1182, __tag__:__POD_NAME__=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, content=最关键的是，这个产能不是等到2027年才落地。根据产业链的最新进展，合肥基地的二期扩产在今年年中就已经进入设备安装调试阶段，下半年就会正式启动产能爬坡，第三季度就能逐步贡献产能。换句话说，今年的中报、三季报，大家大概率就能看到扩产带来的实打实营收增量。, __pack_shard_id__=335, __tag__:__hostname__=gpulingjun033184127160.sa127, __tag__:POD_NAME=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, __tag__:__alipay_zone__=CZ50C, __tag__:__path__=/home/admin/logs/kubemaker.log, __tag__:aistudio=aistudio-345541506, __tag__:__pack_id__=EFA235411D80D906-6D, __pack_cursor__=MTc2NTc2OTkyNDQ4MjA3NTI5OA==}

{__time__=1791774709, __topic__=, __tag__:kubemaker=aistudio-mhmgjdsy, __source__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:owner=415719, __tag__:__phynode__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:__user_defined_id__=kmaker-sa127-03-aidc,kmaker-main,tnlog-main-all, __tag__:component=training, __tag__:app=pytorch, __pack_num__=2513, __tag__:__env__=prod, __pack_offset__=1184, __tag__:__POD_NAME__=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, content=产能方面，目前合肥基地的HBM月产能大概1.2万片，到今年年底，随着扩产项目落地，这个数字会提升到4万片/月。而且HBM业务的毛利率能达到39%左右，比传统存储封测15%-18%的毛利率高出一大截，这部分高端产能释放，对公司利润的拉动会非常明显。, __pack_shard_id__=335, __tag__:__hostname__=gpulingjun033184127160.sa127, __tag__:POD_NAME=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, __tag__:__alipay_zone__=CZ50C, __tag__:__path__=/home/admin/logs/kubemaker.log, __tag__:aistudio=aistudio-345541506, __tag__:__pack_id__=EFA235411D80D906-6D, __pack_cursor__=MTc2NTc2OTkyNDQ4MjA3NTI5OA==}

{__time__=1791774709, __topic__=, __tag__:kubemaker=aistudio-mhmgjdsy, __source__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:owner=415719, __tag__:__phynode__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:__user_defined_id__=kmaker-sa127-03-aidc,kmaker-main,tnlog-main-all, __tag__:component=training, __tag__:app=pytorch, __pack_num__=2513, __tag__:__env__=prod, __pack_offset__=1185, __tag__:__POD_NAME__=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, content=再看深圳沛顿的6.4亿元扩产项目，主要做DDR5和AI服务器内存模组的封装测试，计划2027年6月全面投产，达产后每月新增500万颗高端存储芯片封装产能，主要对接金士顿、美光这些海外客户的AI服务器订单。这个项目虽然落地时间稍晚，但瞄准的是海外高端市场，是公司长期拓展全球市场份额的关键布局。, __pack_shard_id__=335, __tag__:__hostname__=gpulingjun033184127160.sa127, __tag__:POD_NAME=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, __tag__:__alipay_zone__=CZ50C, __tag__:__path__=/home/admin/logs/kubemaker.log, __tag__:aistudio=aistudio-345541506, __tag__:__pack_id__=EFA235411D80D906-6D, __pack_cursor__=MTc2NTc2OTkyNDQ4MjA3NTI5OA==}

{__time__=1791774709, __topic__=, __tag__:kubemaker=aistudio-mhmgjdsy, __source__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:owner=415719, __tag__:__phynode__=33.184.127.160, __tag__:__user_defined_id__=kmaker-sa127-03-aidc,kmaker-main,tnlog-main-all, __tag__:component=training, __tag__:app=pytorch, __pack_num__=2513, __tag__:__env__=prod, __pack_offset__=1820, __tag__:__POD_NAME__=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, content=最关键的是，这个产能不是等到2027年才落地。根据产业链的最新进展，合肥基地的二期扩产在今年年中就已经进入设备安装调试阶段，下半年就会正式启动产能爬坡，第三季度就能逐步贡献产能。换句话说，今年的中报、三季报，大家大概率就能看到扩产带来的实打实营收增量。, __pack_shard_id__=335, __tag__:__hostname__=gpulingjun033184127160.sa127, __tag__:POD_NAME=aistudio-mhmgjdsy-ptjob-master-0, __tag__:__alipay_zone__=CZ50C, __tag__:__path__=/home/admin/logs/kubemaker.log, __tag__:aistudio=aistudio-345541506, __tag__:__pack_id__=EFA235411D80D906-6D, __pack_cursor__=MTc2NTc2OTkyNDQ4MjA3NTI5OA==}
